title: ConfigSchema
description: Public schema representation of the v1 config format, used for JSON Schema generation.

addons.description: Addon configurations (script filters, web searches, etc.)

keyword_min_chars.description:
Characters to type before addon keywords are suggested (default: 3).
A keyword typed in full is always suggested.

AppsAddonConfig.description: Configuration for listing installed applications next to the launchers

actions.description:
Also list the actions applications declare, such as Firefox's
"New Private Window" (default: true).

enabled.description:
List the installed desktop applications after the launchers
(default: false). Apps named like a launcher, or running the same
command, are left out.

AudioAddonConfig.description: Configuration for the audio device switcher addon

close_on_action.description:
Close Raffi after an action instead of staying open and refreshing
the list (default: `general.close_on_action`, else false).

max_volume.description: Highest output volume the volume rows set, in percent (default: 100).

trigger.description: Keyword that opens the audio device list (default: `audio`).

volume_step.description:
Percent the Volume up and Volume down rows change the output volume
by (default: 5).

BitwardenAddonConfig.description: Configuration for the Bitwarden addon, backed by rbw

clipboard_timeout.description:
Seconds before a copied secret is cleared from the clipboard
(default: 45, 0 = never).

close_on_action.description: Close Raffi after copying a secret (default: `general.close_on_action`, else true).

trigger.description: Keyword that opens the vault list (default: `bw`).

type_delay_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait after Raffi closes before typing (default: 200).

close_on_action.description:
Close Raffi after an action instead of staying open and refreshing
the list (default: `general.close_on_action`, else false).

trigger.description: Keyword that opens the Bluetooth list (default: `bt`).

BookmarkBrowser.description: A browser the bookmarks addon reads from or opens links with

BookmarkOpener.description:
What opens a bookmark: a browser name, or a command whose `{url}`
arguments are replaced by the link

BookmarkSourceConfig.description: One place bookmarks are read from

browser.description:
Browser whose profiles hold the bookmarks. Optional with `path`,
where it only picks the browser that opens the links.

folder.description: Only list this folder, such as `Bookmarks Toolbar/Work`.

name.description: Label of the source in the list (default: the browser and profile).

open_with.description:
Opens this source's bookmarks (default: `addons.bookmarks.open_with`,
else the browser and profile they come from).

path.description:
A bookmarks file read directly: Chromium's `Bookmarks`, Firefox's
`places.sqlite`, or the profile directory holding one.

profile.description: Profile to read, by name or directory (default: every profile).

BookmarksAddonConfig.description: Configuration for the browser bookmarks addon (native UI only)

close_on_action.description: Close Raffi after opening a bookmark (default: `general.close_on_action`, else true).

open_with.description:
Opens bookmarks of every source without its own `open_with`
(default: the browser and profile they come from).

sources.description:
Where bookmarks come from (default: every profile of every supported
browser found).

BrowserTabsAddonConfig.description:
Configuration for the browser tabs addon, fed by the Vicinae browser
extension

close_on_action.description: Close Raffi after switching to a tab (default: `general.close_on_action`, else true).

favicon_service.description:
Where to download site icons the browsers have not stored themselves
(default: `twenty`). Downloading sends the domains of open tabs to
that service; `none` keeps favicons to the browsers' own and stops
fetching the selected page for its preview.

trigger.description: Keyword that opens the tab list (default: `tabs`).

close_on_action.description: Close Raffi after copying a calculation result (default: `general.close_on_action`, else true).

ClipboardAction.description: What the clipboard addon does with the selected history item

oneOf.description: Put the item back on the clipboard with all of its formats

Copy the item, then paste it into the window that had focus before
Raffi opened (Hyprland only)

ClipboardAddonConfig.description: Configuration for the clipboard history addon

close_on_action.description: Close Raffi after copying a clipboard entry (default: `general.close_on_action`, else true).

enabled.description:
Unset turns it on when a CopyQ process is running at startup;
`true` or `false` overrides the detection.

min_chars.description:
Hide text entries shorter than this many characters, ignoring
surrounding whitespace (default: 3). Images and files are always shown.

ClipboardBackend.description: Clipboard manager that stores the history browsed by the clipboard addon

oneOf.description: CopyQ, through its command line scripting API

ClipboardHistory.description: Clipboard manager used for `{clipboard:N}` snippet placeholders

oneOf.description: Use whichever of cliphist, CopyQ or clipman is running
Read history with `cliphist list` and `cliphist decode`
Read history with `copyq read`
Read clipman's JSON history file
Disable clipboard history placeholders

ColorAddonConfig.description: Configuration for the inline color converter addon

close_on_action.description: Close Raffi after copying a color value (default: `general.close_on_action`, else true).
Close Raffi after copying a conversion result (default: `general.close_on_action`, else true).

DevtoolsAddonConfig.description:
Configuration for the developer tools addon: the `dev` transform list
and the inline `uuid` and `pw` generators

close_on_action.description: Close Raffi after copying a generated or transformed value (default: `general.close_on_action`, else true).

password_length.description:
Length of passwords generated by `pw` without a length, from 8 to 128
(default: 20).

trigger.description: Keyword that opens the transform list (default: `dev`).

EmojiAddonConfig.description: Configuration for the emoji picker addon

close_on_action.description: Close Raffi after executing an emoji action (default: `general.close_on_action`, else true).

FaviconService.description: Service asked for the favicons of sites the browsers have none for

oneOf.description: twenty-icons.com, the Vicinae default
Google's favicon service
Never download; only use what the browsers stored

FileBrowserAddonConfig.description: Configuration for the file browser addon

action.description:
Action on Enter for files: `open` (xdg-open), `copy`, `insert`, or a
shell command where `{value}` is the full path. Defaults to `open`.

close_on_action.description: Close Raffi after executing a file browser action (default: `general.close_on_action`, else true).

fido_style.description:
Edit paths the way Emacs fido-mode does: Backspace on a trailing `/`
goes up to the parent directory, and typing `~/` or `/` right after a
`/` starts over from home or the root. Off, the input is plain text.

file_manager.description:
File manager opened with Ctrl+B on the browsed directory. `{value}` is
replaced by the directory, otherwise it is appended as the last
argument. Nautilus, Dolphin, Nemo and Caja also get the selected entry
highlighted. Autodetected when unset.

preview_command.description:
Command that previews the selected entry in the preview pane.
Unset uses the previewer bundled with raffi when python3 is
installed; `none` turns it off. A command runs through `sh -c` with
the path appended as the last argument (also in `$RAFFI_VALUE`) and
prints ANSI text or a Script Filter preview object; no output or a
non-zero exit keeps the built-in preview. Killed after 3 seconds.

secondary_action.description:
Action on Ctrl+Enter for files and directories, with the same values as
`action`. Defaults to `copy`.

show.description:
Initial filter of the listing: `all`, `files` or `directories`;
Ctrl+Tab cycles through them.

sort.description:
Initial order of the listing; Ctrl+S cycles through the modes.
Directories are always listed first.

sort_reverse.description:
Reverse the sort order: Z to A, or oldest first for date sorts.
Directories stay first and Ctrl+S keeps this setting.

FileBrowserShow.description: Which entries the file browser lists

oneOf.description: Directories and files
Files only
Directories only (`dirs` and `directory` are accepted as aliases)
Alphabetical, case-insensitive
Last modification time, newest first (`date` is accepted as an alias)
Creation time, newest first, where the filesystem records it

blur.description:
Ask the compositor to blur what shows through the window
(KDE/KWin; other compositors use their own rules). Default: true.

close_on_action.description:
Close Raffi after executing an action (default: true).
Addon and launcher `close_on_action` settings override this.

main_view.description:
Sources mixed into the main view, in display order, when typing without
an addon trigger. Entries: `launchers`, `browser_tabs`,
`bookmarks`, `windows`, `system`, `media`, `audio`, `bluetooth`, `pass`,
`text_snippets.<name>` and `script_filters.<name>`. When set, launchers
only show if `launchers` is listed.

main_view_chips.description:
What the chips row above the apps shows on an empty query when
`main_view` is set: `name` (default), `keyword` or `off`

opacity.description:
Opacity of the window backgrounds, from 0.0 (see-through) to 1.0
(the theme as designed). Text and icons stay opaque. Default: 0.95.

preview.description: Appearance of the right-hand preview pane (font, size, colours, width)

renderer.description:
Renderer for the window: `auto` (default: `gpu` when `opacity` is
below 1, else `cpu`), `cpu` (faster to open, opaque on Wayland) or `gpu`.
An `ICED_BACKEND` environment variable takes precedence.

show_preview.description:
Show the Alfred-style right-hand preview pane.
By default, previews are shown automatically for addons (snippets, file browser,
script filters, etc.) and hidden for standard launcher entries unless `show_preview: true`
is set in `general` or on the launcher entry. Can also be toggled at runtime with Ctrl+P.

show_tips.description:
Show a tip about a keyword in the empty search box, such as
`clip for Clipboard history` (default: true).

terminal_classes.description:
Extra window classes treated as terminals by `hypr_paste` (sent Ctrl+Shift+V
instead of Ctrl+V). Added to the built-in list; matched case-insensitively.

KillAddonConfig.description: Configuration for the kill process addon

close_on_action.description:
Close Raffi after sending a signal instead of staying open and refreshing
the list (default: `general.close_on_action`, else false).

trigger.description: Keyword that opens the process list (default: `kill`).

MainViewChips.description: What the chips on an empty main view query show

oneOf.description: A short name such as "Tabs" or "Clipboard"
The keyword that starts the plugin, such as `tabs` or `clip`
No chips: an empty query starts with the apps

MediaAddonConfig.description: Configuration for the media controls addon

close_on_action.description:
Close Raffi after an action instead of staying open and refreshing
the list (default: `general.close_on_action`, else false).

trigger.description: Keyword that opens the media controls (default: `media`).

clipboard_timeout.description:
Seconds before a copied secret is cleared from the clipboard
(default: 45, 0 = never).

close_on_action.description: Close Raffi after copying a secret (default: `general.close_on_action`, else true).

pinentry.description: Who asks for the GPG passphrase: `raffi` (default) or `agent`.

trigger.description: Keyword that opens the password list (default: `pass`).

type_delay_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait after Raffi closes before typing (default: 200).

username_fields.description:
`key: value` lines read as the username, tried in this order (default:
`login`, `user`, `username`). Falls back to the entry file name.

PassPinentry.description: Who asks for the GPG passphrase when a pass entry needs one

oneOf.description:
Raffi shows its own masked prompt and hands the passphrase to gpg
through loopback pinentry

Raffi closes and gpg-agent shows its usual pinentry (smartcards,
YubiKeys, or setups that forbid loopback)

PreviewColorsConfig.description: Colour overrides for the right-hand preview pane (hex: #RGB, #RRGGBB, or #RRGGBBAA).

bg.description: Background of the whole preview pane

bg_block.description: Background of the content/code blocks inside the pane

PreviewConfig.description: Appearance settings for the right-hand preview pane.

colors.description: Colour overrides for the preview pane

font_family.description:
Font family for the preview pane, including message, snippet and
clipboard text (default: the UI font)

font_size.description:
Base font size in px for preview text (default: 0.8 × general font_size,
16 at the default 20). Title, headings and hero values scale from it.

mono_font_family.description:
Monospace font family for code blocks such as file contents, commands
and script output (default: system monospace)

width_percent.description: Width of the preview pane as a percentage of the window (10-80, default: 50)

RaffiConfig.description: Represents the configuration for each Raffi entry.

alias.description:
Route this launcher to an internal command: picking it types this text
for you, such as `mp linus/linux` (an addon keyword
followed by its query). Cannot be combined with `binary`, `script` or
`args`.

close_on_action.description: Close Raffi after launching this entry (default: `general.close_on_action`, else true).

keyword.description:
Keyword that stands for `alias` while typing: with keyword `linoux`,
typing `linoux torvalds` searches `mp linus/linux torvalds`
while the input keeps showing `linoux torvalds`. Requires `alias`; no
whitespace.

show_preview.description: Show the right-hand preview pane when this launcher entry is selected (default: false).

oneOf.description:
`gpu` when `opacity` is below 1, since only the GPU renderer shows
transparency on Wayland, `cpu` otherwise

Software rendering: opens faster because no GPU driver has to be loaded.
The window stays opaque on Wayland.
GPU rendering through Vulkan, falling back to software if no GPU is usable

ScriptFilterConfig.description: Configuration for a script filter addon

close_on_action.description: Close Raffi after executing an action on a result (default: `general.close_on_action`, else true).

dynamic_preview.description:
Re-run the command with `RAFFI_PREVIEW=1` for the selected item and show
the preview object it prints (default: true).

cache_minutes.description:
Minutes the cached conversations, people, muted conversations and
searches count as fresh before Raffi asks Slack again (default: 60);
0 asks every time. Cached rows and previews show at once while the
fresh ones load.

close_on_action.description: Close Raffi after opening a conversation or message (default: `general.close_on_action`, else true).

cookie_command.description:
Shell command printing the value of the `d` cookie, needed with a
session (`xoxc-`) token.

enabled.description: Off by default: the addon needs a Slack token.

message_order.description:
Order of the messages in the previews (default: `newest_first`).
Threads keep their first message on top.

open_in.description:
Open conversations in the desktop app or in the browser (default:
desktop). Ctrl+Enter uses the other one.

token_command.description:
Shell command printing the Slack token: a user token (`xoxp-`) from
your own Slack app, or the session token (`xoxc-`) of a logged-in
browser tab.

trigger.description: Keyword that opens the Slack list (default: `slack`).

unread_conversations.description:
Conversations to check for unread messages (`#channel`, `@user` or
an id), up to 30, used when Slack does not report unread
conversations for the token, as with `xoxp-` tokens.

SlackMessageOrder.description: Order of the messages in the Slack previews

oneOf.description: The newest message on top
The oldest message on top, as in Slack

SlackOpenIn.description: Where the Slack addon opens conversations

oneOf.description: The Slack desktop app, through `slack://` links
The browser, through `https://app.slack.com` links

SortMode.description: Sort mode for launcher entries, text snippets and password entries by past use

oneOf.description: Sort by launch count (most frequently used first)
Sort by last-used time (most recently used first)
Combined score: 40% frequency + 60% recency

SystemAddonConfig.description: Configuration for the system commands addon

close_on_action.description: Close Raffi after running a system command (default: `general.close_on_action`, else true).

hide.description: Entries left out of the list.

SystemCommand.description: A built-in entry of the system commands addon

SystemCommandsConfig.description:
Commands replacing the built-in ones of the system commands addon, as
argument lists run without a shell. An empty list hides the entry.

logout.description:
Default: Hyprland's exit dispatcher on Hyprland (through `hyprctl eval`
with a Lua config, `hyprctl dispatch exit` otherwise),
`niri msg action quit --skip-confirmation` on niri, `swaymsg exit` on
sway, otherwise
`loginctl terminate-session $XDG_SESSION_ID`.

TerminalAddonConfig.description: Configuration for the run in terminal addon

close_on_action.description: Close Raffi after running a command in the terminal (default: `general.close_on_action`, else true).

command.description:
Terminal command line the command to run is appended to, such as
`[alacritty, -e]`. Found automatically when unset: xdg-terminal-exec,
then `$TERMINAL`, then the first known terminal installed.

hold.description:
Keep the terminal open once the command exits, until Enter is
pressed (default: true).

kitty_socket.description:
kitty remote control address, such as
`unix:${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR}/kitty`, as given to kitty's `listen_on`.
Read from kitty.conf when unset.

trigger.description: Keyword that runs the rest of the query in a terminal (default: `>`).

TerminalOpenIn.description: Where the terminal addon opens typed commands

oneOf.description: A new tab of the running kitty or WezTerm, else a new window
Always a new window

icon.description: Emoji, icon name, or image path overriding the source icon.

keyword.description: Optional short keyword; an exact match ranks the snippet first.

TextSnippetSourceConfig.description: Configuration for a text snippet source

close_on_action.description: Close Raffi after executing a snippet action (default: `general.close_on_action`, else true).

placeholders.description: Expand dynamic placeholders such as {clipboard} and {date} in snippet values.

restore_clipboard.description: Best-effort restoration of plain text after the `hypr_paste` action.

UnitsAddonConfig.description: Configuration for the inline unit converter addon

close_on_action.description: Close Raffi after copying a converted value (default: `general.close_on_action`, else true).

WebSearchConfig.description: Configuration for a web search addon

close_on_action.description: Close Raffi after opening a web search URL (default: `general.close_on_action`, else true).

WindowsAddonConfig.description: Configuration for the window switcher addon for Hyprland, niri and sway

close_on_action.description: Close Raffi after focusing or moving a window (default: `general.close_on_action`, else true).

trigger.description: Keyword that opens the window list (default: `win`).

WorldClockAddonConfig.description: Configuration for the inline world clock addon

close_on_action.description: Close Raffi after copying a time value (default: `general.close_on_action`, else true).
